evals.prompt: I want to build a free open-source alternative to 2anything - it's that paid tool that converts files between a zillion formats in the browser. Can you research their public website and give me an implementation-ready spec package my coding agent can actually build from? Save everything under research/2anything-spec/.
evals.expected_output: Full docs/00-14 package under research/2anything-spec/docs/ plus research/evidence-log.md, with VERIFIED/INFERRED/UNKNOWN/NOT TESTED labels and [E-xx] refs. Quality gate passes.

assertions.text: All 14 contract docs (docs/00 through docs/14) exist and are non-empty
Evidence log exists with at least 5 E-xx rows
Capability matrix: every table data row includes VERIFIED, INFERRED, UNKNOWN, or NOT TESTED
Every [E-xx] reference in docs resolves to a row in the evidence log
No TODO/TBD/FIXME placeholders in any doc
Quality gate script runs and exits 0
Format conversion matrix present (input/output formats enumerated)
Honest about target platform (notes 2anything is a desktop/.app product or that the .com domain is parked, not a browser tool)
